title: AL App Manifest
description: Schema for app.json — the AL extension/app manifest for Business Central

id.description: The unique ID (GUID) of the extension. Used at runtime to bind table names; changing it orphans existing data.

name.description: The unique extension name. May be used by other extensions to express a compile-time dependency.

publisher.description: The name of the publisher. May be used by other extensions to express a compile-time dependency.

version.description: The version of the app package in Major.Minor.Build.Revision format.

brief.description: Short description of the extension (required for Marketplace submission).

description.description: Longer description of the extension (required for Marketplace submission).

privacyStatement.description: URL to the privacy statement for the extension (required for Marketplace submission).

EULA.description: URL to the license terms (end-user license agreement) for the extension (required for Marketplace submission).

help.description: URL to online help and troubleshooting content. Used in Marketplace; can match contextSensitiveHelpUrl (required for Marketplace submission).

helpBaseUrl.description: URL that overrides all Help for the specified locales. Intended for localization apps; requires supportedLocales to be set. Overrides the default /{0}/dynamics365/business-central.

contextSensitiveHelpUrl.description: Base URL for context-sensitive Help, e.g. https://mysite.com/documentation/. Include a /{0}/ locale placeholder if not all locales are supported, and set supportedLocales (required for Marketplace submission).

url.description: URL of the extension package, shown as Website on the Extension Management page (required for Marketplace submission).

logo.description: Relative path to the app package logo from the root of the package (required for Marketplace submission).

platform.description: Minimum supported version of the platform (Microsoft_System) package. Required if system objects are referenced.

application.description: Supported version of the system + base application (Microsoft_Application) package. Required if the system/base application is referenced.

test.description: Version of the dependent test framework in X.Y.U.Z format. Only supported for Business Central version 14 and earlier (C/AL base app).

runtime.description: The AL runtime version the project targets (e.g. 13.0, 14.0, 15.0, 16.0). The project can be published to a server supporting the same or higher runtime. If omitted, the highest available major version is used.

target.description: Compilation target. Defaults to Cloud. Use OnPrem on-premises to access restricted APIs and .NET Interop. Internal and Extension are legacy synonyms.

features.description: List of AL compiler features to enable.

idRange.description: A single range of allowed application object IDs. Use either idRange or idRanges, not both.

from.description: First object ID in the range (inclusive).

to.description: Last object ID in the range (inclusive).

idRanges.description: A list of allowed application object ID ranges. Use either idRange or idRanges, not both. Overlapping ranges are not allowed.

from.description: First object ID in the range (inclusive).

to.description: Last object ID in the range (inclusive).

dependencies.description: List of dependencies for the extension package. The version specified is the minimum version. Use appId instead of id when runtime is 4.0 or earlier.

id.description: The app ID (GUID) of the dependency.

appId.description: Legacy alternative to id, used when runtime is 4.0 or earlier.

internalsVisibleTo.description: List of modules granted access to objects marked Internal via the Access property in the current module.

id.description: The app ID (GUID) of the module granted access.

name.description: Name of the module granted access.

publisher.description: Publisher of the module granted access.

propagateDependencies.description: Whether the direct dependencies of this project are propagated as direct dependencies of projects that depend on it. Default is false.

alternateIds.description: IDs of applications that will be replaced by this application. Used by apps that replace the base application.

screenshots.description: Relative paths to screenshot files to include in the extension package.

resourceFolders.description: List of folders containing resources to be packaged with this extension.

supportedLocales.description: List of locales supported in Help if different from all locales. The first locale is the default, e.g. ["da-DK", "en-US"].

resourceExposurePolicy.description: Defines accessibility of resources and source code during different operations. All defaults are false.

applyToDevExtension.description: Apply the policy to the development (RAD) extension.

allowDebugging.description: Allow debugging into this extension's source.

includeSourceInSymbolFile.description: Include source code in the symbol (.app) file.

preprocessorSymbols.description: Symbols to use with preprocessor directives, e.g. ["DEBUG", "PROD"].

suppressWarnings.description: Warning IDs whose diagnostics should not be shown in the Output window, e.g. ["AL0458"].

keyVaultUrls.description: URLs of Azure Key Vaults from which the extension can retrieve secrets. All must belong to the same Microsoft Entra tenant.

applicationInsightsConnectionString.description: Connection string of the Azure Application Insights resource used for telemetry (recommended for Marketplace submission).

applicationInsightsKey.description: Instrumentation key of the Azure Application Insights resource (legacy; prefer applicationInsightsConnectionString).

source.description: Source control properties. Can be set via the alc.exe command line, overriding values here.

repositoryUrl.description: URL of the repository where the project source code can be found.

commit.description: Source code commit ID for the current version of the project.

build.description: Build properties. Can be set via the alc.exe command line, overriding values here.

by.description: The build agent/system that orchestrated the build, e.g. AL-Go for GitHub.

url.description: URL to the build system invocation where the build can be found.

showMyCode.description: Expose source code (legacy; use resourceExposurePolicy instead).
